description: Rated wallet JSON export: top-level metadata, an overall block (aggregated attribute groups), and a perVariant object with one key per variant (MOBILE, DESKTOP, BROWSER, EMBEDDED, HARDWARE) present in variants, each with the same attribute-group structure as overall.

$schema.description: URL of the JSON Schema for this document.

types.description: Wallet types (SOFTWARE, HARDWARE, EMBEDDED) this wallet belongs to.

variants.description: List of variants (MOBILE, DESKTOP, BROWSER, EMBEDDED, HARDWARE) this wallet has. Each variant in this list has a corresponding key in perVariant with the same attribute-group structure as overall.

lastUpdated.description: Date the wallet data was last updated (YYYY-MM-DD).

stage.description: Walletbeat stage label, or null if not applicable.

oneOf.description: Per-stage criteria passed/total and status for the primary ladder; null when stage is not applicable.

website.description: Primary website URL for the wallet, when known.

repository.description: Primary source code repository URL, when known.

overall.description: Aggregated evaluation across all variants. Keys are attribute group ids (e.g. security, privacy); values are objects keyed by attribute id, each with attribute metadata and evaluation block.

perVariant.description: Per-variant evaluation blocks. Keys are variant names (MOBILE, DESKTOP, BROWSER, EMBEDDED, HARDWARE); only variants listed in the variants array appear. Each value has the same structure as overall (attribute groups keyed by group id, then attribute id, then attribute + evaluation block).

stageBreakdownItem.description: One stage in the ladder: id, label, criteria counts, derived status, and per-group/criterion details.

criteriaGroups.description: Criteria groups, each with a description and per-criterion details.

stageCriteriaGroupBreakdownItem.description: One criteria group within a stage: a description plus a list of criteria.

stageCriterionBreakdownItem.description: One criterion within a stage: display name, description, and rating.

attributeGroupsExport.description: Map of attribute group id (e.g. security, privacy) to group export (attribute id to attribute + evaluation block). Used for overall and for each variant block.

attributeGroupExport.description: One attribute group: map of attribute id to attribute export block (attribute metadata + evaluation).

attributeExportBlock.description: Single attribute export: attribute metadata (display name, question, methodology) plus wallet-specific evaluation (rating, shortExplanation, details, optional impact, howToImprove, references).

shortQuestion.description: Short question describing what the attribute evaluates (e.g. "Can you send and receive tokens without revealing your transaction history to others?")

whyItMatters.description: Body of the "Why does this matter?" / "Why should I care?" section

howIsEvaluated.description: Section heading and body for "How is this attribute evaluated?"

ratingBlock.description: Wallet-specific evaluation result for one attribute (rating, explanation, details, optional impact, howToImprove, references).

rating.description: Attribute rating for this wallet. PASS: wallet meets the attribute's criteria. FAIL: wallet does not meet the criteria. PARTIAL: wallet partially meets the criteria. UNRATED: insufficient feature data to evaluate. EXEMPT: attribute is not applicable to this wallet (e.g. by type or profile).

shortExplanation.description: Brief explanation of why this rating was assigned.

details.description: Longer explanation or summary of the evaluation; may be "See full details on the wallet page." when details are not easily expressed in textual format.

reference.description: Optional reference with explanation and one or more URLs.
